query.zh: 配送中心每天向客户群体供应必需品。“customer_demand.csv”记录各客户群体的每日需求，“supply_capacity.csv”记录各配送中心的每日供应能力，“transportation_costs.csv”记录各配送中心到客户群体的单位运输成本。求各条路径的运输量，使所有客户需求得到满足、各配送中心的发货量不超过供应能力，并使总运输成本最小。
query.en: Distribution centers supply essential goods to customer groups each day. "customer_demand.csv" gives daily customer demand, "supply_capacity.csv" gives daily distribution-center capacity, and "transportation_costs.csv" gives the unit cost for each route. Determine shipment quantities that meet all customer demand, stay within each center’s capacity, and minimize total transportation cost.

csvObservation.zh: CSVQA 结果包含三份源表的全部 54 行：18 个客户的需求、18 个配送中心的供应能力，以及 18 行×18 列的运输成本矩阵。示例：C1 需求为 4415，S1 供应能力为 5963，S1→C1 单位运输成本为 159.83765495858208。
csvObservation.en: CSVQA output includes all 54 rows from three source tables: demand for 18 customers, capacity for 18 distribution centers, and an 18-by-18 transportation-cost matrix. Example values: C1 demand 4415; S1 capacity 5963; S1→C1 unit cost 159.83765495858208.

objective.zh: 最小化所有配送中心到客户群体的总运输成本。
objective.en: Minimize total transportation cost from distribution centers to customer groups.

variables.zh: xᵢⱼ ≥ 0：从配送中心 i 运往客户群体 j 的连续货物数量，共 324 个决策变量。
variables.en: xᵢⱼ ≥ 0: the continuous quantity shipped from distribution center i to customer group j; 324 decision variables.

constraints.zh: 需求满足：每个客户群体收到的总货物数量不低于其需求。
constraints.en: Demand satisfaction: total shipments to each customer group meet or exceed its demand.

constraints.zh: 供应能力：每个配送中心运出的总货物数量不超过其供应能力。
constraints.en: Supply capacity: total shipments from each distribution center do not exceed its capacity.

constraints.zh: 非负性：所有运输数量均为非负连续变量。
constraints.en: Non-negativity: all shipment quantities are nonnegative continuous variables.

model.latex: \begin{aligned}\min\quad &\sum_{i\in I}\sum_{j\in J}c_{ij}x_{ij}\\\text{s.t.}\quad &\sum_{i\in I}x_{ij}\ge d_j &&\forall j\in J\\&\sum_{j\in J}x_{ij}\le s_i &&\forall i\in I\\&x_{ij}\ge 0 &&\forall i\in I,\ j\in J\end{aligned}
